members.name: judge-4
members.prompt:
You are judging proposed automated tests against a rubric. Read-only task.

READ FIRST:
1. `/Users/ryanducharme/.claude/jira-watch/prompts/validate.md`, section "Which proposed tests get written" — this is the rubric. Apply it exactly.
2. Your proposals: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ryanducharme-dev-orci/8f64a84a-629e-4548-8435-e2d0830179b0/scratchpad/slice-4.md`

REPO: `/Users/ryanducharme/dev/orci`, on `main`. STRICTLY READ-ONLY. Do not edit any file, do not create files in the repo, do not run git checkout/branch/stash, do not run builds. Reading and grepping only. Write only to your output file below.

ALREADY VERIFIED — do not re-investigate, just apply:
- Root `pom.xml` surefire excludes `**/*IntegrationTest.java` and NO workflow in `.github/workflows/` passes `-P integration-tests`. So any proposal whose only home is a `*IntegrationTest` class is INERT and fails rubric bar 1. Decline it with reason "integration-test class, never runs in CI".
- The webapp has no unit test runner (no vitest). Frontend-only unit tests are unwritable; decline as "no webapp unit runner".
- Analytics tests (anything under `orci/src/main/analytics/`) are reserved — another engineer owns them. Decline as "analytics, reserved".

YOUR JOB, per proposal:
- Work out the concrete destination file it would land in (a qa-suite spec under `qa-suite/`, or a Java test class under `orci/src/test/java/...` or a module's `src/test/java`).
- OPEN that file (and grep for the behavior) and check whether it is already covered. Covered → decline.
- Judge it against all six bars. Be strict: the historical decline rate on this backlog is ~92%, and the goal is real, efficient tests, not volume. Specifically decline: assertions on log strings, golden/snapshot tables that force an edit per new row, tests of build/CI/pom/Liquibase config, duplicates of a sibling assertion, and absence assertions with no way to prove them red.
- A test KEEPs only if it asserts real behavior, in a file that actually runs, that is not already covered, and can be shown to fail.

OUTPUT: write `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ryanducharme-dev-orci/8f64a84a-629e-4548-8435-e2d0830179b0/scratchpad/verdicts-4.tsv`, one tab-separated line per proposal, SAME ORDER as the slice file, no header:

PROPOSAL_ID<TAB>KEEP or DECLINE<TAB>destination file path (or "-" if declined)<TAB>one-line reason

The reason is mandatory for both verdicts. For DECLINE it must name which bar it fails. Keep reasons under 120 chars.

Report back only: counts (kept/declined), the output file path, and the 3 strongest KEEPs with a one-line justification each. Do not paste the full table.
